symptom: A child of the cloud worker exhausted the VM's memory. The kernel killed that child, and systemd's default OOMPolicy=stop then failed the whole worker service, cancelling the running turn and ending every terminal.
rule: The worker unit sets OOMPolicy=continue, and the installer upgrades an older unit without restarting a running worker; a kernel OOM kill inside a service's cgroup stops the unit unless the unit says otherwise.
check: pnpm --dir apps/control-plane exec vitest run src/cloud/runtime.test.ts -t 'leaves an unchanged VM untouched without any privileged command'
